adobe.metodo_titulo: HOW DO YOU WANT TO INSTALL ADOBE?
adobe.metodo_tools_default: Required tools will be downloaded automatically based on the selected method.
adobe.selecciona_metodo: Select an Adobe installation method to continue.
adobe.tools_auto: Tools that will be downloaded automatically: {tools}
adobe.fullpack_subtitulo: Your code includes all available Adobe applications.
adobe.modo_rapido_desc: We use the fastest and easiest method (AIO MacKed). Ideal if you want everything ready without complications.
adobe.modo_especifico_desc: Choose among the methods compatible with your selection.
adobe.rapido_subtitulo: Recommended method. Download pre-patched apps in a single package.
adobe.especifico_subtitulo: Compare the options and choose the one that fits you best.
adobe.aio_macked_desc: The most balanced method and the one that supports the newest versions.
adobe.aio_macked_warning: Prerequisite (MANUAL): uninstall previous Adobe versions and close Creative Cloud BEFORE installing. The method won't do it for you.
adobe.aio_macked_bullet1: Supports the most recent versions of each app. It does not update itself, but it works with the new ones.
adobe.aio_macked_bullet2: Includes tools like Adobe Genuine Pop-Up Blocker and Adobe Sanitizer, which are downloaded with the method.
adobe.aio_macked_bullet3: Shows the badge of the group that patched it when you open the apps. It is just the signature and stays there, it cannot be removed.
adobe.aio_sice_desc: Useful if you want to use it directly, without blocking anything on the system.
adobe.aio_sice_warning: Only works with the versions it ships with, not with new updates.
adobe.aio_sice_bullet1: No firewall or connection blocking needed. It installs and works.
adobe.aio_sice_bullet2: Comes with the Photoshop AI plugin (Nano Banana) included.
adobe.aio_sice_bullet3: Does not include Neural Filters or Lightroom Develop: this method patches without an account, and those features require being signed in to Adobe.
adobe.aio_sice_bullet4: Includes the Sentinel tool, which is downloaded with the method.
adobe.multilang_sice_desc: The SiCe option, but in the language you are looking for.
adobe.multilang_sice_warning: Select the correct language during installation. Only works with the versions it ships with.
adobe.multilang_sice_bullet1: Available in Spanish, French, Portuguese and more.
adobe.multilang_sice_bullet2: Same as the others: no firewall, no account, it installs and works.
adobe.multilang_sice_bullet3: Does not include Neural Filters or Lightroom Develop: this method patches without an account, and those features require being signed in to Adobe.
adobe.multilang_sice_bullet4: Includes tools: Sentinel, AntiCC and Adobe Cleaner Tool, which are downloaded with the method.
adobe.activation_tool_desc: The one that gives you full control to choose each app and version.
adobe.activation_tool_warning: Requires signing in to Adobe Creative Cloud (with an Adobe account).
adobe.activation_tool_bullet1: You install the official apps (from Creative Cloud or Adobe Downloader) and then apply the patch.
adobe.activation_tool_bullet2: Includes Neural Filters and Lightroom Develop (account-based features).
adobe.activation_tool_bullet3: Does not always support the latest version: you must check what version each patch supports.
adobe.activation_tool_bullet4: Includes tools: Sentinel, AntiCC, Adobe ACC Runtime and Adobe Downloader, which are downloaded with the method.

descarga.rustdesk_desc:
RustDesk lets us connect to your computer during a video call to install everything for you.

It is optional: if you choose not to install it, you can still download the files, but you will need to install them yourself or coordinate another way to get assistance.
descarga.ya_instalado_desc:
{nombre} was detected as already installed.

No need to download it again.

Press NEXT to continue.
descarga.no_instalado_desc:
{nombre} was not found on your computer.

It is needed for us to perform the remote installation.
You can install it now, or continue with the download only.
descarga.rustdesk_omitir_mensaje:
RustDesk lets us guide you during installation via video call.

If you skip it, you can still download the files, but you will need to install them manually. Do you want to install it now?
descarga.rustdesk_fallo_mensaje:
Could not download or install RustDesk.

Without it, you can only install files manually. Do you want to retry?
descarga.error_descarga_desc:
Could not download {nombre}.
This tool will be skipped.
descarga.metodo_bloqueado_desc:
The links for this method are broken, so it is blocked until the next app update.

Choose another method or try again later.
descarga.instalando_desc: Accept the installer steps and wait for it to finish.
descarga.instalado_ok_desc:
{nombre} was installed successfully.

We can now connect to your computer during the video call.

Press NEXT to continue.
descarga.surge_desc: Surge is a download accelerator that runs automatically in the background. You don't need to interact with it and it will close itself when finished.
descarga.surge_info:
What happens now?
Surge will open several simultaneous connections to download files faster. A Windows or macOS Firewall window may appear asking for network permission for SyopS Prep.

You must click ALLOW / PERMITIR so downloads can work.
descarga.torrent_desc: We will use the BitTorrent network (libtorrent) to download the selected programs. It is normal for the first few seconds to take time while connecting to other peers.
descarga.torrent_info:
Important: When the Windows or macOS Firewall asks if you want to allow network connections for SyopS Prep, click ALLOW / PERMITIR.

Why? Torrent needs to connect to other computers to download the files. Without this permission, the download will not work.

You may also appear as a 'peer' while downloading, but the program only shares what is necessary to complete the download.
descarga.error_libtorrent_desc: The BitTorrent download engine could not initialize. This is usually a packaging issue. Continue to generate the invoice and contact the provider.
descarga.links_faltantes_desc: Contact the provider to configure the download links.
descarga.nada_para_descargar:
No files to download.
Go to the next screen.
descarga.completadas_desc:

Next, an invoice will be generated
with your computer info and the

descarga.procesando_desc:

This will take a few seconds.
descarga.archivos_listos_desc:

Press NEXT to generate

descarga.descargas_resumen_fallido:

{fail_list}

descarga.archivos_ok_desc:

Press NEXT to continue.

info.desc_optimizacion:
Two complementary tools working together:
Mole cleans unnecessary files and optimizes the system.
Talon removes bloatware and Windows telemetry.
info.desc_permanente:
Lightweight firewall that blocks internet access
for specific applications, keeping your
Adobe programs permanently protected.
info.feat_mole:
MOLE
• Deep cleaning: temps, caches, logs
• Smart uninstaller with residue cleanup
• Visual disk analyzer and live monitor

TALON
• Windows debloat in 2 clicks
• Removes built-in AI and telemetry
• Reduces RAM usage and system resources
info.feat_permanente:
• Cuts network connections per application
• Prevents patches from being undone
• Blocks Windows telemetry
• Simple interface without pop-ups
info.nota_optimizacion:
These tools don't count toward the limit
of 3 programs. They are free add-ons.
info.nota_permanente:
SimpleWall doesn't count toward the selection limit.
It's an additional free add-on.
info.tool_mole:
Mole: System cleaning and optimization.
Removes temps, caches, and app residues.

Talon: Windows debloat in 2 clicks.
Removes bloatware, AI, and telemetry
to free system resources.
info.tool_mole_solo:
System cleaning and optimization.
Removes temps, caches, and residues.
info.tool_talon_solo:
Windows debloat in 2 clicks.
Removes bloatware, AI, and telemetry.
info.tool_simplewall:
Firewall that cuts network connections
for specific applications.

Ideal for protecting Adobe patches
by blocking their internet access.

privacidad.texto:
SyopS Prep only collects the information necessary to coordinate the service:

• CPU model, RAM amount and disk space (to check compatibility).
• Computer name and operating system (for remote diagnosis).
• Selected programs (to prepare installation).
• Name, phone number and availability (to contact you via WhatsApp).

We do not collect passwords from your accounts, personal files or browsing history.

Do you agree that we securely send this minimal diagnostic and contact data to our systems to manage your service?
privacidad.mensaje_rechazo:
To continue you must accept sending the minimum diagnostic and contact data.

Without this information we cannot coordinate the remote installation.
